```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# pILC cohort-wide epigenetic-program analysis (no predefined clusters)
# Date: 2026-09-23
# Seed: 42
#
# Scientific questions
#   1. Which epigenetic programs show relatively high RNA activity across pILC?
#   2. Which programs vary most between tumors?
#   3. Which tumors show unusually high activity for individual programs?
#   4. Do samples form unsupervised groups based on epigenetic programs alone?
#
# Important interpretation
#   ssGSEA/GSVA scores are relative expression-enrichment scores. They do not
#   prove absolute biochemical pathway activation. “High activity” below means
#   high relative to the other tumors or to the other included epigenetic gene
#   sets, depending on the reported metric.
# ==============================================================================

set.seed(42)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Packages
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_packages <- c(
  "data.table", "ggplot2", "GSVA", "BiocParallel", "pheatmap",
  "RColorBrewer", "scales"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall CRAN packages with install.packages() and Bioconductor packages ",
    "with BiocManager::install()."
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(GSVA)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(scales)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Inputs and output directory
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

vst_file <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/",
  "VST_data/htseq_VST_gene_names_all_expression_filtered_genes.csv"
)

c5_gmt_file <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/",
  "c5.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
)

clinical_file <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation/",
  "pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv"
)

out_dir <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/",
  "Epigenetic_Pathway_Analysis/Cohort_Wide_2026-09-23"
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(vst_file)) stop("VST file not found: ", vst_file)
if (!file.exists(c5_gmt_file)) stop("C5 GMT file not found: ", c5_gmt_file)
if (!file.exists(clinical_file)) stop("Clinical file not found: ", clinical_file)

date_tag <- "2026-09-23"
min_gene_set_size <- 5L
max_gene_set_size <- 500L
high_z_threshold <- 1.5
n_bootstrap <- 2000L
top_n_heatmap <- 40L
top_n_plot <- 25L

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", ".")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

normalize_sample_id <- function(x) {
  # TP03.117, TP03_117 and TP03-117 all become TP03-117.
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- gsub("[._]+", "-", x)
  x <- gsub("-+", "-", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-S[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x
}

parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  # For interval-censored values such as <5, use the midpoint 2.5 for plotting.
  raw <- trimws(as.character(x))
  raw[raw %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", ".")] <- NA_character_
  value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", raw)))
  is_below <- !is.na(raw) & grepl("^<", raw)
  value[is_below] <- value[is_below] / 2
  value
}

clean_receptor_status <- function(x) {
  y <- trimws(as.character(x))
  y <- gsub("\\s+", " ", y)
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(y))
  out[grepl("^Positive", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^Negative", y, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Negative"
  out[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(y)] <- "Unknown"
  out
}

clean_grade <- function(x) {
  y <- trimws(as.character(x))
  y <- gsub("\\s+", " ", y)
  out <- y
  out[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(y)] <- "Unknown"
  out
}

read_gmt <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  parsed <- strsplit(lines, "\t", fixed = TRUE)

  gene_sets <- lapply(parsed, function(x) {
    if (length(x) < 3L) return(character())
    unique(clean_gene_symbol(x[-c(1L, 2L)]))
  })

  set_names <- vapply(parsed, function(x) x[1L], character(1))
  names(gene_sets) <- make.unique(set_names)
  gene_sets <- gene_sets[lengths(gene_sets) > 0L]
  gene_sets
}

median_bootstrap_ci <- function(x, n_boot = 2000L, seed = 42L) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2L) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  set.seed(seed)
  medians <- replicate(
    n_boot,
    median(sample(x, size = length(x), replace = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  as.numeric(stats::quantile(medians, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))
}

robust_z <- function(x) {
  center <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  spread <- mad(x, center = center, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(spread) || spread == 0) spread <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(spread) || spread == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - center) / spread
}

row_zscore <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  z
}

sample_percentile_matrix <- function(score_matrix) {
  apply(score_matrix, 2L, function(x) {
    if (sum(is.finite(x)) <= 1L) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
    (rank(x, na.last = "keep", ties.method = "average") - 1) /
      (sum(is.finite(x)) - 1)
  })
}

classify_pathway <- function(pathway_name) {
  x <- toupper(pathway_name)
  if (grepl("SWI_SNF|BAF|SMARCA|SMARCB", x)) return("SWI/SNF-BAF")
  if (grepl("PRC1|POLYCOMB_REPRESSIVE_COMPLEX_1", x)) return("PRC1")
  if (grepl("PRC2|POLYCOMB_REPRESSIVE_COMPLEX_2", x)) return("PRC2")
  if (grepl("DNA_DEMETHYL|TET_DIOXYGENASE", x)) return("DNA demethylation")
  if (grepl("DNA_METHYL|METHYLCYTOSINE|CPG", x)) return("DNA methylation")
  if (grepl("HDAC|HISTONE_DEACETYL", x)) return("Histone deacetylation")
  if (grepl("HAT|HISTONE_ACETYL|ACETYLTRANSFERASE", x)) return("Histone acetylation")
  if (grepl("HISTONE.*DEMETHYL|DEMETHYLASE", x)) return("Histone demethylation")
  if (grepl("HISTONE.*METHYL|METHYLTRANSFERASE", x)) return("Histone methylation")
  if (grepl("HETEROCHROMATIN", x)) return("Heterochromatin")
  if (grepl("NUCLEOSOME", x)) return("Nucleosome organization")
  if (grepl("CHROMATIN", x)) return("Chromatin regulation")
  if (grepl("EPIGEN", x)) return("Other epigenetic")
  "Other epigenetic"
}

run_ssgsea <- function(expr_matrix, gene_sets) {
  # GSVA >= 1.50 uses a parameter object. Older versions use gsva() arguments.
  if (exists("ssgseaParam", where = asNamespace("GSVA"), inherits = FALSE)) {
    param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(
      exprData = expr_matrix,
      geneSets = gene_sets,
      minSize = min_gene_set_size,
      maxSize = max_gene_set_size,
      alpha = 0.25,
      normalize = TRUE
    )
    GSVA::gsva(
      param,
      verbose = TRUE,
      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(progressbar = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    GSVA::gsva(
      expr = expr_matrix,
      gset.idx.list = gene_sets,
      method = "ssgsea",
      kcdf = "Gaussian",
      min.sz = min_gene_set_size,
      max.sz = max_gene_set_size,
      mx.diff = TRUE,
      ssgsea.norm = TRUE,
      parallel.sz = 1L,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  }
}

save_plot_pair <- function(plot_object, stem, width, height) {
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(stem, "_", date_tag, ".png")),
    plot_object, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(stem, "_", date_tag, ".pdf")),
    plot_object, width = width, height = height, bg = "white"
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Read and validate the VST expression matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Reading VST expression matrix...")
vst_dt <- fread(vst_file, check.names = FALSE)

if (ncol(vst_dt) < 3L) {
  stop("The VST file must contain one gene column and at least two samples.")
}

gene_col <- names(vst_dt)[1L]
setnames(vst_dt, gene_col, "Gene")
vst_dt[, Gene := clean_gene_symbol(Gene)]
vst_dt <- vst_dt[!is.na(Gene)]

sample_columns <- setdiff(names(vst_dt), "Gene")
vst_dt[, (sample_columns) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = sample_columns]

if (anyNA(vst_dt[, ..sample_columns])) {
  na_by_sample <- vapply(vst_dt[, ..sample_columns], function(x) sum(is.na(x)), integer(1))
  stop(
    "Missing or nonnumeric VST values detected. Counts by sample: ",
    paste(names(na_by_sample)[na_by_sample > 0], na_by_sample[na_by_sample > 0],
          sep = "=", collapse = "; ")
  )
}

# Average duplicated gene symbols so that each gene occurs once.
vst_dt <- vst_dt[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), by = Gene, .SDcols = sample_columns]

expr <- as.matrix(vst_dt[, ..sample_columns])
rownames(expr) <- vst_dt$Gene
storage.mode(expr) <- "double"

zero_variance_genes <- apply(expr, 1L, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
expr <- expr[!zero_variance_genes, , drop = FALSE]

message("Genes retained: ", nrow(expr))
message("Samples retained: ", ncol(expr))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Read, clean and match clinical annotations to RNA samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Reading and matching clinical annotations...")
clinical_raw <- fread(clinical_file, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", "N/A", ""))

required_clinical_cols <- c(
  "Sample",
  "tumor_cellularity (%)",
  "pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)",
  "TILs (%)",
  "Grade/Differentiation-Desc",
  "BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc",
  "Tumor Marker #1 (ER)",
  "Tumor Marker #2 (PR)"
)

missing_clinical_cols <- setdiff(required_clinical_cols, names(clinical_raw))
if (length(missing_clinical_cols) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required clinical columns: ",
    paste(missing_clinical_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

clinical_dt <- clinical_raw[, .(
  Clinical_sample_original = as.character(Sample),
  Sample_key = normalize_sample_id(Sample),
  Tumor_cellularity_raw = as.character(`tumor_cellularity (%)`),
  Pleomorphic_percent_raw = as.character(`pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)`),
  TILs_percent_raw = as.character(`TILs (%)`),
  Grade_raw = as.character(`Grade/Differentiation-Desc`),
  HER2_raw = as.character(`BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc`),
  ER_raw = as.character(`Tumor Marker #1 (ER)`),
  PR_raw = as.character(`Tumor Marker #2 (PR)`)
)]

clinical_dt[, `:=`(
  Tumor_cellularity_percent = parse_percent_value(Tumor_cellularity_raw),
  Pleomorphic_percent = parse_percent_value(Pleomorphic_percent_raw),
  TILs_percent = parse_percent_value(TILs_percent_raw),
  Grade = clean_grade(Grade_raw),
  HER2 = clean_receptor_status(HER2_raw),
  ER = clean_receptor_status(ER_raw),
  PR = clean_receptor_status(PR_raw)
)]

if (anyDuplicated(clinical_dt$Sample_key)) {
  duplicate_keys <- unique(clinical_dt$Sample_key[duplicated(clinical_dt$Sample_key)])
  stop(
    "Duplicated clinical sample IDs after normalization: ",
    paste(duplicate_keys, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

expression_samples <- data.table(
  RNA_sample_original = colnames(expr),
  Sample_key = normalize_sample_id(colnames(expr))
)

if (anyDuplicated(expression_samples$Sample_key)) {
  duplicate_keys <- unique(
    expression_samples$Sample_key[duplicated(expression_samples$Sample_key)]
  )
  stop(
    "Duplicated RNA sample IDs after normalization: ",
    paste(duplicate_keys, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

clinical_match <- merge(
  expression_samples,
  clinical_dt,
  by = "Sample_key",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
clinical_match[, RNA_order__ := match(RNA_sample_original, colnames(expr))]
setorder(clinical_match, RNA_order__)
clinical_match[, RNA_order__ := NULL]
clinical_match[, Match_status := ifelse(
  is.na(Clinical_sample_original), "RNA sample unmatched", "Matched"
)]

clinical_only <- clinical_dt[!Sample_key %in% expression_samples$Sample_key]
if (nrow(clinical_only) > 0L) {
  clinical_only_audit <- copy(clinical_only)
  clinical_only_audit[, `:=`(
    RNA_sample_original = NA_character_,
    Match_status = "Clinical sample absent from RNA matrix"
  )]
  setcolorder(clinical_only_audit, names(clinical_match))
  clinical_audit <- rbind(clinical_match, clinical_only_audit, fill = TRUE)
} else {
  clinical_audit <- copy(clinical_match)
}

fwrite(
  clinical_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("RNA_clinical_sample_matching_audit_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

if (any(clinical_match$Match_status != "Matched")) {
  warning(
    "Unmatched RNA samples: ",
    paste(clinical_match[Match_status != "Matched", RNA_sample_original], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# pheatmap requires row names of annotation_col to match matrix column names.
clinical_annotation_dt <- clinical_match[, .(
  Sample = RNA_sample_original,
  `Tumor cell. (%)` = Tumor_cellularity_percent,
  `Pleomorphic (%)` = Pleomorphic_percent,
  `TILs (%)` = TILs_percent,
  Grade,
  HER2,
  ER,
  PR
)]

clinical_annotation <- as.data.frame(clinical_annotation_dt)
rownames(clinical_annotation) <- clinical_annotation$Sample
clinical_annotation$Sample <- NULL

clinical_annotation$Grade <- factor(clinical_annotation$Grade)
for (receptor in c("HER2", "ER", "PR")) {
  clinical_annotation[[receptor]] <- factor(
    clinical_annotation[[receptor]],
    levels = c("Negative", "Positive", "Unknown")
  )
}

grade_cols <- c(
  "Grade I" = "#A6CEE3",
  "Grade II" = "#33A02C",
  "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
  "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD"
)

observed_grade_levels <- unique(na.omit(as.character(clinical_annotation$Grade)))
missing_grade_levels <- setdiff(observed_grade_levels, names(grade_cols))
if (length(missing_grade_levels) > 0L) {
  extra_grade_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing_grade_levels), palette = "Dark 3")
  names(extra_grade_cols) <- missing_grade_levels
  grade_cols <- c(grade_cols, extra_grade_cols)
}

binary_receptor_cols <- c(
  "Negative" = "#1F78B4",
  "Positive" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD"
)

annotation_colors <- list(
  `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B"))(100),
  `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRampPalette(c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B"))(100),
  # Preserve the original oncoplot anchors: 0 = pale, 30 = red, 100 = dark red.
  `TILs (%)` = c(
    colorRampPalette(c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A"))(31),
    colorRampPalette(c("#FB6A4A", "#67000D"))(71)[-1]
  ),
  Grade = grade_cols,
  HER2 = binary_receptor_cols,
  ER = binary_receptor_cols,
  PR = binary_receptor_cols
)

fwrite(
  clinical_annotation_dt,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("heatmap_clinical_annotations_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Define focused epigenetic gene sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Reading C5 gene sets...")
c5_sets_all <- read_gmt(c5_gmt_file)

# Focused name filter. This deliberately avoids generic RNA methylation terms.
epigenetic_name_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    "CHROMATIN", "HISTONE", "EPIGEN", "DNA_METHYL", "DNA_DEMETHYL",
    "METHYLCYTOSINE", "SWI_SNF", "BAF_COMPLEX", "POLYCOMB",
    "PRC1", "PRC2", "HDAC", "HISTONE_ACETYL", "NUCLEOSOME",
    "HETEROCHROMATIN"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

c5_sets <- c5_sets_all[grepl(epigenetic_name_pattern, names(c5_sets_all), ignore.case = TRUE)]
names(c5_sets) <- paste0("C5__", names(c5_sets))

# Curated pathway modules provide interpretable coverage of major programs.
curated_sets <- list(
  CURATED__SWI_SNF_BAF_CORE = c(
    "ARID1A", "ARID1B", "ARID2", "SMARCA2", "SMARCA4", "SMARCB1",
    "SMARCC1", "SMARCC2", "SMARCD1", "SMARCD2", "SMARCD3", "SMARCE1",
    "ACTL6A", "BRD7", "BRD9", "DPF1", "DPF2", "DPF3", "PBRM1",
    "BCL7A", "BCL7B", "BCL7C", "SS18"
  ),
  CURATED__PRC1 = c(
    "BMI1", "PCGF1", "PCGF2", "PCGF3", "PCGF4", "PCGF5", "PCGF6",
    "RING1", "RNF2", "CBX2", "CBX4", "CBX6", "CBX7", "CBX8",
    "PHC1", "PHC2", "PHC3", "SCMH1"
  ),
  CURATED__PRC2 = c(
    "EZH1", "EZH2", "EED", "SUZ12", "RBBP4", "RBBP7", "JARID2",
    "AEBP2", "PHF1", "MTF2", "PHF19"
  ),
  CURATED__HDAC_DEACETYLATION = c(
    paste0("HDAC", 1:11), paste0("SIRT", 1:7), "SIN3A", "SIN3B", "NCOR1", "NCOR2"
  ),
  CURATED__HAT_ACETYLATION = c(
    "KAT2A", "KAT2B", "KAT5", "KAT6A", "KAT6B", "KAT7", "KAT8",
    "EP300", "CREBBP", "NCOA1", "NCOA2", "NCOA3", "CLOCK", "TAF1", "HAT1"
  ),
  CURATED__DNA_METHYLATION_WRITERS_READERS = c(
    "DNMT1", "DNMT3A", "DNMT3B", "DNMT3L", "UHRF1", "UHRF2",
    "MBD1", "MBD2", "MBD3", "MBD4", "MBD5", "MBD6", "MECP2",
    "ZBTB33", "ZBTB38", "ZBTB4"
  ),
  CURATED__DNA_DEMETHYLATION = c(
    "TET1", "TET2", "TET3", "TDG", "GADD45A", "GADD45B", "GADD45G",
    "AICDA", "APOBEC1"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_LYSINE_METHYLTRANSFERASES = c(
    "KMT2A", "KMT2B", "KMT2C", "KMT2D", "SETD1A", "SETD1B", "SETD2",
    "EHMT1", "EHMT2", "SUV39H1", "SUV39H2", "SETDB1", "SETDB2",
    "NSD1", "NSD2", "NSD3", "DOT1L", "EZH1", "EZH2", "SETD6", "SETD7"
  ),
  CURATED__HISTONE_DEMETHYLASES = c(
    "KDM1A", "KDM1B", "KDM2A", "KDM2B", "KDM3A", "KDM3B", "KDM3C",
    "KDM4A", "KDM4B", "KDM4C", "KDM4D", "KDM5A", "KDM5B", "KDM5C",
    "KDM5D", "KDM6A", "KDM6B", "KDM7A", "KDM8", "JMJD6"
  ),
  CURATED__CHROMATIN_REMODELING_EXPANDED = c(
    paste0("CHD", 1:9), "INO80", "INO80B", "INO80C", "INO80D", "INO80E",
    "SRCAP", "EP400", "ATRX", "DAXX", "HELLS", "RSF1", "CECR2",
    "ARID1A", "ARID1B", "ARID2", "SMARCA2", "SMARCA4", "SMARCB1",
    "SMARCC1", "SMARCC2", "PBRM1"
  )
)

curated_sets <- lapply(curated_sets, clean_gene_symbol)
all_sets_unfiltered <- c(c5_sets, curated_sets)

# Retain only genes present in the expression matrix and enforce set-size limits.
gene_set_audit <- rbindlist(lapply(names(all_sets_unfiltered), function(nm) {
  original <- unique(all_sets_unfiltered[[nm]])
  expressed <- intersect(original, rownames(expr))
  data.table(
    Pathway = nm,
    Source = ifelse(grepl("^CURATED__", nm), "Curated", "C5"),
    Original_gene_count = length(original),
    Expressed_gene_count = length(expressed),
    Coverage_percent = round(100 * length(expressed) / max(1L, length(original)), 2),
    Retained_for_scoring = length(expressed) >= min_gene_set_size &&
      length(expressed) <= max_gene_set_size,
    Expressed_genes = paste(sort(expressed), collapse = ";")
  )
}))

fwrite(
  gene_set_audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_gene_set_audit_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

gene_sets <- lapply(all_sets_unfiltered, function(x) intersect(unique(x), rownames(expr)))
gene_sets <- gene_sets[
  lengths(gene_sets) >= min_gene_set_size & lengths(gene_sets) <= max_gene_set_size
]

if (length(gene_sets) < 2L) {
  stop("Fewer than two epigenetic gene sets passed the expressed-gene filters.")
}

message("Epigenetic gene sets retained: ", length(gene_sets))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Calculate sample-level ssGSEA scores
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message("Running ssGSEA across all samples (no cluster labels)...")
ssgsea_scores <- run_ssgsea(expr, gene_sets)
ssgsea_scores <- as.matrix(ssgsea_scores)

if (nrow(ssgsea_scores) < 2L || ncol(ssgsea_scores) != ncol(expr)) {
  stop("Unexpected ssGSEA output dimensions.")
}

score_wide <- data.table(Pathway = rownames(ssgsea_scores), ssgsea_scores)
fwrite(
  score_wide,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_ssGSEA_scores_wide_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

score_long <- melt(
  score_wide,
  id.vars = "Pathway",
  variable.name = "Sample",
  value.name = "ssGSEA_score"
)
score_long[, Category := vapply(Pathway, classify_pathway, character(1))]

fwrite(
  score_long,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_ssGSEA_scores_long_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Derive activity, variability and pathway-high metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Relative pathway activity: percentile rank among the included epigenetic
# pathways within each sample. This is preferable to directly comparing raw
# ssGSEA magnitudes across different gene sets.
activity_percentiles <- sample_percentile_matrix(ssgsea_scores)
rownames(activity_percentiles) <- rownames(ssgsea_scores)
colnames(activity_percentiles) <- colnames(ssgsea_scores)

# Pathway-specific robust Z scores across samples identify unusually high tumors.
robust_z_matrix <- t(apply(ssgsea_scores, 1L, robust_z))
rownames(robust_z_matrix) <- rownames(ssgsea_scores)
colnames(robust_z_matrix) <- colnames(ssgsea_scores)

activity_wide <- data.table(Pathway = rownames(activity_percentiles), activity_percentiles)
z_wide <- data.table(Pathway = rownames(robust_z_matrix), robust_z_matrix)

fwrite(
  activity_wide,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_activity_percentiles_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)
fwrite(
  z_wide,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_robust_z_scores_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

summary_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ssgsea_scores)), function(i) {
  pathway <- rownames(ssgsea_scores)[i]
  x <- as.numeric(ssgsea_scores[i, ])
  pctl <- as.numeric(activity_percentiles[i, ])
  z <- as.numeric(robust_z_matrix[i, ])
  ci <- median_bootstrap_ci(x, n_bootstrap, seed = 42L + i)

  high_samples <- colnames(ssgsea_scores)[z >= high_z_threshold]
  low_samples <- colnames(ssgsea_scores)[z <= -high_z_threshold]

  data.table(
    Pathway = pathway,
    Source = ifelse(grepl("^CURATED__", pathway), "Curated", "C5"),
    Category = classify_pathway(pathway),
    Expressed_gene_count = length(gene_sets[[pathway]]),
    Samples = length(x),
    Mean_ssGSEA = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_ssGSEA = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_95CI_low = ci[1L],
    Median_95CI_high = ci[2L],
    SD_ssGSEA = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_ssGSEA = IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAD_ssGSEA = mad(x, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_ssGSEA = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_ssGSEA = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_activity_percentile = median(pctl, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_activity_percentile = mean(pctl, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pathway_high_threshold_robust_z = high_z_threshold,
    Pathway_high_samples_n = length(high_samples),
    Pathway_high_samples_percent = 100 * length(high_samples) / length(x),
    Pathway_low_samples_n = length(low_samples),
    Pathway_low_samples_percent = 100 * length(low_samples) / length(x),
    Pathway_high_samples = paste(high_samples, collapse = ";"),
    Pathway_low_samples = paste(low_samples, collapse = ";")
  )
})

pathway_summary <- rbindlist(summary_list)
pathway_summary[, Relative_activity_rank := frank(-Median_activity_percentile, ties.method = "min")]
pathway_summary[, Variability_rank_MAD := frank(-MAD_ssGSEA, ties.method = "min")]
setorder(pathway_summary, Relative_activity_rank, Variability_rank_MAD)

fwrite(
  pathway_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_pathway_summary_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

fwrite(
  pathway_summary[order(Variability_rank_MAD)],
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_pathways_ranked_by_variability_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# One table per sample: top relative pathways and number of pathway-high calls.
sample_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(colnames(ssgsea_scores), function(sample_id) {
  pctl <- activity_percentiles[, sample_id]
  z <- robust_z_matrix[, sample_id]
  ord <- order(pctl, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
  top_pathways <- rownames(activity_percentiles)[head(ord, 5L)]
  high_pathways <- rownames(robust_z_matrix)[which(z >= high_z_threshold)]
  data.table(
    Sample = sample_id,
    Number_pathway_high_calls = length(high_pathways),
    Top_5_relative_epigenetic_pathways = paste(top_pathways, collapse = ";"),
    Pathway_high_programs = paste(high_pathways, collapse = ";")
  )
}))

fwrite(
  sample_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_sample_summary_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Heatmaps: unsupervised sample and pathway clustering
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

top_variable_names <- pathway_summary[
  order(Variability_rank_MAD), head(Pathway, min(top_n_heatmap, .N))
]
heatmap_matrix <- row_zscore(ssgsea_scores[top_variable_names, , drop = FALSE])

heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(101)

png(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Top_variable_epigenetic_programs_heatmap_", date_tag, ".png")),
  width = 3600, height = 3000, res = 300
)
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  annotation_col = clinical_annotation[colnames(heatmap_matrix), , drop = FALSE],
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  annotation_names_col = TRUE,
  color = heatmap_colors,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  border_color = NA,
  na_col = "#E5E5E5",
  fontsize_row = 7,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "Most variable epigenetic programs across pILC tumors\nRow-scaled ssGSEA scores; unsupervised clustering",
  angle_col = 45
)
dev.off()

pdf(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Top_variable_epigenetic_programs_heatmap_", date_tag, ".pdf")),
  width = 12, height = 11
)
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  annotation_col = clinical_annotation[colnames(heatmap_matrix), , drop = FALSE],
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  annotation_names_col = TRUE,
  color = heatmap_colors,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  border_color = NA,
  na_col = "#E5E5E5",
  fontsize_row = 7,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "Most variable epigenetic programs across pILC tumors\nRow-scaled ssGSEA scores; unsupervised clustering",
  angle_col = 45
)
dev.off()

curated_names <- intersect(names(curated_sets), rownames(ssgsea_scores))
if (length(curated_names) >= 2L) {
  curated_heatmap <- row_zscore(ssgsea_scores[curated_names, , drop = FALSE])

  png(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Curated_epigenetic_programs_heatmap_", date_tag, ".png")),
    width = 3300, height = 1900, res = 300
  )
  pheatmap(
    curated_heatmap,
    annotation_col = clinical_annotation[colnames(curated_heatmap), , drop = FALSE],
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    annotation_names_col = TRUE,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    na_col = "#E5E5E5",
    fontsize_row = 9,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    main = "Core epigenetic programs across pILC tumors\nRow-scaled ssGSEA scores; unsupervised clustering",
    angle_col = 45
  )
  dev.off()

  pdf(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Curated_epigenetic_programs_heatmap_", date_tag, ".pdf")),
    width = 12, height = 7
  )
  pheatmap(
    curated_heatmap,
    annotation_col = clinical_annotation[colnames(curated_heatmap), , drop = FALSE],
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    annotation_names_col = TRUE,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    na_col = "#E5E5E5",
    fontsize_row = 9,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    main = "Core epigenetic programs across pILC tumors\nRow-scaled ssGSEA scores; unsupervised clustering",
    angle_col = 45
  )
  dev.off()
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Ranked activity and variability plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

activity_plot_dt <- copy(pathway_summary[order(Relative_activity_rank)][1:min(top_n_plot, .N)])
activity_plot_dt[, Pathway_label := factor(Pathway, levels = rev(Pathway))]

p_activity <- ggplot(
  activity_plot_dt,
  aes(x = Pathway_label, y = Median_activity_percentile, fill = Category)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Epigenetic programs with highest relative activity across pILC",
    subtitle = "Median within-sample percentile among included epigenetic programs",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Median relative activity percentile",
    fill = "Program class"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

save_plot_pair(p_activity, "Top_relative_activity_epigenetic_programs", 11, 9)

variability_plot_dt <- copy(pathway_summary[order(Variability_rank_MAD)][1:min(top_n_plot, .N)])
variability_plot_dt[, Pathway_label := factor(Pathway, levels = rev(Pathway))]

p_variability <- ggplot(
  variability_plot_dt,
  aes(x = Pathway_label, y = MAD_ssGSEA, fill = Category)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Most variable epigenetic programs across pILC tumors",
    subtitle = "Variability measured by median absolute deviation of raw ssGSEA scores",
    x = NULL,
    y = "MAD of ssGSEA score",
    fill = "Program class"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

save_plot_pair(p_variability, "Top_variable_epigenetic_programs", 11, 9)

# Activity-versus-variability overview.
p_overview <- ggplot(
  pathway_summary,
  aes(
    x = Median_activity_percentile,
    y = MAD_ssGSEA,
    size = Expressed_gene_count,
    color = Category
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 9)) +
  labs(
    title = "Relative activity and intertumoral variability of epigenetic programs",
    subtitle = "Each point represents one pathway",
    x = "Median relative activity percentile",
    y = "MAD of raw ssGSEA score",
    size = "Expressed genes",
    color = "Program class"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "right")

save_plot_pair(p_overview, "Epigenetic_activity_vs_variability_overview", 11, 8)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Pathway-high fractions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

high_plot_dt <- pathway_summary[
  Pathway_high_samples_n > 0
][order(-Pathway_high_samples_percent)][1:min(top_n_plot, .N)]

if (nrow(high_plot_dt) > 0L) {
  high_plot_dt <- copy(high_plot_dt)
  high_plot_dt[, Pathway_label := factor(Pathway, levels = rev(Pathway))]

  p_high <- ggplot(
    high_plot_dt,
    aes(x = Pathway_label, y = Pathway_high_samples_percent, fill = Category)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(Pathway_high_samples_n, "/", Samples)),
      hjust = -0.08, size = 3
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(high_plot_dt$Pathway_high_samples_percent) * 1.20),
      labels = function(x) paste0(round(x), "%")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Epigenetic programs elevated in subsets of pILC tumors",
      subtitle = paste0("Pathway-high: robust Z score >= ", high_z_threshold,
                        " relative to the cohort"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Pathway-high tumors",
      fill = "Program class"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  save_plot_pair(p_high, "Pathway_high_tumor_fractions", 11, 9)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Unsupervised PCA based on epigenetic pathway scores
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pca_input <- t(row_zscore(ssgsea_scores))
pca_fit <- prcomp(pca_input, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pca_var <- 100 * (pca_fit$sdev^2 / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2))

pca_dt <- data.table(
  Sample = rownames(pca_fit$x),
  PC1 = pca_fit$x[, 1L],
  PC2 = pca_fit$x[, 2L]
)

fwrite(
  pca_dt,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_pathway_PCA_scores_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_dt, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Sample)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#2C7FB8") +
  geom_text(check_overlap = TRUE, nudge_y = 0.15, size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Unsupervised pILC sample structure from epigenetic programs",
    subtitle = "PCA of row-scaled ssGSEA scores; no predefined cluster labels",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_var[1L], 1), "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_var[2L], 1), "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_plot_pair(p_pca, "Unsupervised_epigenetic_pathway_PCA", 10, 8)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Correlation heatmap for curated and highly variable pathways
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

corr_names <- unique(c(curated_names, head(top_variable_names, 20L)))
corr_names <- intersect(corr_names, rownames(ssgsea_scores))

if (length(corr_names) >= 3L) {
  pathway_cor <- cor(t(ssgsea_scores[corr_names, , drop = FALSE]),
                     method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  fwrite(
    data.table(Pathway = rownames(pathway_cor), pathway_cor),
    file.path(table_dir, paste0("epigenetic_pathway_spearman_correlations_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  corr_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(101)
  png(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Epigenetic_pathway_correlation_heatmap_", date_tag, ".png")),
    width = 3000, height = 2700, res = 300
  )
  pheatmap(
    pathway_cor,
    color = corr_colors,
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 6,
    main = "Co-variation among epigenetic programs across pILC tumors"
  )
  dev.off()

  pdf(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Epigenetic_pathway_correlation_heatmap_", date_tag, ".pdf")),
    width = 11, height = 10
  )
  pheatmap(
    pathway_cor,
    color = corr_colors,
    breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 6,
    main = "Co-variation among epigenetic programs across pILC tumors"
  )
  dev.off()
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Analysis audit and completion messages
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

audit <- data.table(
  Item = c(
    "Analysis_date", "Random_seed", "VST_file", "C5_GMT_file", "Clinical_file",
    "Output_directory",
    "Genes_used", "Samples_used", "C5_sets_selected_before_expression_filter",
    "Curated_sets_defined", "Total_sets_scored", "Minimum_gene_set_size",
    "Maximum_gene_set_size", "Pathway_high_robust_Z_threshold",
    "Bootstrap_replicates", "Predefined_clusters_used", "Matched_clinical_samples",
    "Unmatched_RNA_samples", "Clinical_only_samples", "TIL_below_5_plotting_value"
  ),
  Value = c(
    date_tag, "42", vst_file, c5_gmt_file, clinical_file, out_dir,
    as.character(nrow(expr)), as.character(ncol(expr)), as.character(length(c5_sets)),
    as.character(length(curated_sets)), as.character(nrow(ssgsea_scores)),
    as.character(min_gene_set_size), as.character(max_gene_set_size),
    as.character(high_z_threshold), as.character(n_bootstrap), "No",
    as.character(sum(clinical_match$Match_status == "Matched")),
    as.character(sum(clinical_match$Match_status != "Matched")),
    as.character(nrow(clinical_only)), "2.5"
  )
)

fwrite(
  audit,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_analysis_audit_", date_tag, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("R_sessionInfo_", date_tag, ".txt"))
)

message("\nCohort-wide epigenetic analysis completed successfully.")
message("No predefined RNA cluster labels were used.")
message("Results saved under: ", out_dir)
message("Primary summary table: ", file.path(
  table_dir, paste0("cohortwide_epigenetic_pathway_summary_", date_tag, ".tsv")
))
message("Primary heatmap: ", file.path(
  plot_dir, paste0("Top_variable_epigenetic_programs_heatmap_", date_tag, ".png")
))
```
